'''Adrazar''' was a [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who resided in a [[Adrazar's domicile|domicile]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Codex" /> Sometime before [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Adrazar sought to tame the [[Scyk/Legends|scyk]], a lizard-like creature from the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and use the creatures as his servants. He found the scyks to be deadly and eager for battle, but they were unable to cooperate in packs for more than a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]], despite his attempts to train them or manipulate them through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The resultant carnage left only [[Unidentified scyk|one scyk]] alive, which Adrazar then used as a guard for his residence.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adrazar was first mentioned in the Codex entry for scyks in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
